screen.optimizator.title: Optimizator
screen.optimizator.footer: All optimizations are OFF by default
optimizator.help.master: Main switch. Enables the Optimizator features you selected.
optimizator.help.adaptive: Automatically reduces load during sustained low FPS. It can temporarily reduce render and entity distance.
optimizator.help.entities: Skips rendering supported distant entities. Currently this covers dropped items and XP orbs.
optimizator.help.particles: Open the separate menu for particle density, distance, budget, and type rules.
optimizator.help.chunks: Limits GPU chunk uploads per frame so rebuild bursts create fewer frame-time spikes.
optimizator.help.profiler: Open measurements for FPS, frame time, world, entities, particles, and chunk uploads.
optimizator.help.item_culling: Skips rendering distant dropped items. Works when smart entity culling is enabled.
optimizator.help.xp_culling: Skips rendering distant XP orbs. Works when smart entity culling is enabled.
optimizator.help.entity_distance: Supported entities are skipped beyond this distance. Lower values save more work.
optimizator.help.shadow_culling: Skips very distant entity shadows without hiding the entities themselves.
optimizator.help.shadow_distance: Maximum render distance for entity shadows.
optimizator.help.clouds: Temporarily disables clouds during sustained low FPS and restores the user's original setting after recovery.
optimizator.help.adaptive_render_distanc: Lowest chunk distance the adaptive controller may use. Ignored when adaptive mode is off.
optimizator.help.adaptive_entity_distanc: Lowest entity distance the adaptive controller may use.
optimizator.help.adaptive_fps: FPS threshold below which the adaptive controller starts reducing load.
optimizator.help.chunk_uploads: Maximum queued GPU chunk-upload tasks processed in one upload pass.
optimizator.help.chunk_budget: Time budget for processing the chunk upload queue during one upload pass.
optimizator.help.overlay: Shows FPS and the profiler's main bottleneck over the game.
optimizator.help.page_main: Enable the main Optimizator modules here. Numeric tuning is on the following pages.
optimizator.help.page_entities: Tune entity distances, shadows, and cloud behavior during FPS drops here.
optimizator.help.page_performance: Tune adaptive thresholds, chunk uploads, and the profiler overlay here.
screen.particles.title: Particle settings
particles.footer: Changes do not remove textures or simplify models
particles.help.basic: Particle reduction controls spawn density, distance, and the global budget. It does not change particle textures.
particles.help.rules: Enter particle IDs separated by commas. Wildcards are supported, for example minecraft:smoke*.
screen.profiler.title: Performance profiler
profiler.help: The profiler helps find bottlenecks; it does not increase FPS by itself.
